suggested_requirements.text: The tool shall provide the user with a visual indication of faults.
The tool shall provide descriptive information concerning the faults and their causes.
The tool shall provide suggested corrective actions for identified faults.
The tool shall store the results of diagnostics for subsequent retrieval and use.
The user shall manually input and edit fixed data describing the characteristics of the unit under diagnosis.
The tool shall print screen images of diagnostic results and historical data at user request.
The tool shall permit the user to supply metadata relevant to the results, such as location and serial number.
The tool shall obtain sensed data from real-time data acquisition devices and data files.
The administrator shall start and stop diagnostic processing through the status menu.
The tool shall display a list of buildings under diagnosis on the main window.
The tool shall display historical results in the form of a color map.
The tool shall save configuration changes to permanent storage upon user confirmation.
The tool shall authenticate the user by obtaining a user name and password.
The tool shall associate the absolute time of input with each sensed data item.
The tool shall validate sensed data against expected minimum and maximum ranges.
The tool shall convert sensed data to required engineering units such as Degrees F and Amps.
The tool shall monitor performance and operational parameters for chillers and cooling towers to identify specific faults.
The tool shall log all errors associated with obtaining, validating, converting, or storing sensed data.
Setting up and operating the automated diagnostic tool should require minimal user input.
The automated diagnostic tool must support a wide variety of users with respect to computer expertise.
The tool shall be restricted to Microsoft Windows-compatible operating systems.
The tool shall automatically revert user privileges to those of a general user if 15 minutes of inactivity elapses.
The tool shall permit only three attempts at authentication before dismissing the authentication window.
Sensed data input to the tool shall be stored to permanent storage with a precision of three significant figures.
